## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior or documentation structure.
Name the slice and its prospective contract when applicable.

## Validation

Record the locked sync, Ruff, mypy, pytest and whitespace results. Include
frontend checks when affected and the relevant independent numerical audit.
For documentation, check links, preserved evidence and ignore behavior.

## Evidence and scope

Link the relevant protocol/report and state the Gate result, limitations and next
slice. Explain any numerical tolerance change. Documentation maintenance needs
no new scientific Gate.

- [ ] Only reviewed source, documentation and configuration paths are staged.
- [ ] Generated data/models, runtime artifacts, secrets and local drafts stay external.
- [ ] Historical failures, costs, fixed-primary and sealed-evidence boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Current status, roadmap and indices are updated where the slice requires them.
- [ ] Public claims remain within the supporting evidence.
